content.text: Co-sleeping at 5 is really common, and kids this age respond well to a plan they help make. Tonight, tell him the new step ahead of time and let him pick something for his own bed, like a stuffed animal or a night light. Then do the usual bedtime routine and stay with him in his bed until he's drowsy, instead of him falling asleep in yours. That keeps the change small, and it's the first step to moving out slowly.
